name: Gisa's undead moondrake
description: An undead moondrake Gisa calls from the estuary muck, which kills a Phyrexian moondrake.

description_citations.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
description_citations.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Gisa draws in the death of Innistrad and calls a moondrake and ghouls from the estuary muck.
timeline.quote: the undead moondrake she had called from the muck rose, majestic, into the sky.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian moondrake rises, and Gisa's moondrake kills it in the air and on the ground, spoiling a Phyrexian plan.
timeline.quote: her drake ripped the other's head clean off
